dedup.scope: Focused fixed-source and bisequent-title metadata lookup across all three indexes found no related primary. The later2610.08293 dependence-like paper cites these original proofs rather than reproducing them, and no task was created from those citation-only proof lines. Counted targets are constructive cut admissibility and constructive interpolation, each once across its logic-family clauses; auxiliary structural rules not separate counts.

editorial_notes: Complete original mathematical body, all original inference trees and embedded bibliography retained. Authors own mathematical correctness; no missing proof supplied or independently certified.
Official arXiv source is a gzip-compressed single TeX file; original downloaded bytes retained unchanged despite archive filename, decompressed BisequentsLLP.tex is the raw author source.
Source0 changes utf8x to standard utf8, replaces publication T2A encoding with T1 for the English/Latin standalone and omits ucs; original raw source retained and mathematics unchanged.

The source preliminary note credits the earlier conference version and identifies newly expanded syntactic proofs; citation-only proof lines of the later dependence-like source are not counted as complete new author proofs.
License recorded from arXiv v1 CC BY4.0; journal published-version license is not substituted for this version.

Revision r002 supplies original cached bussproofs.sty (LPPL1.3+) and original proof.sty from lkproof (GPL1 or later) as local assets with copyright, license and provenance. Package code, mathematical source and all proof trees unchanged; failed r001 retained, no global installation.
